rules.name: Visible focus
rules.requirement: Interactive controls expose a visible focus treatment.

rules.name: Button contrast
rules.requirement: Primary button text/background contrast is at least 4.5:1.

rules.name: Invalid input feedback
rules.requirement: Automatically detected input errors identify the affected field in visible text, describe the needed correction, and are programmatically associated with the control. Invalid styling preserves visible focus.

rules.name: Button target size
rules.requirement: Buttons declare a minimum target of at least 40px in both dimensions. This is a product rule, not a claim that WCAG requires 40px.

rules.name: Button focus ring contrast
rules.requirement: A button's mapped focus ring color has at least 3:1 contrast against the primary surface. Check other adjacent surfaces in rendered use.

rules.name: Dialog accessible name
rules.requirement: A dialog is programmatically named by its visible title.

rules.name: Dialog focus management
rules.requirement: Opening a dialog moves focus inside it, keeps focus inside while open, and returns focus to its trigger on close.

rules.name: Dialog Escape dismissal
rules.requirement: Escape closes a dialog when dismissal is allowed. Any non-dismissible exception must be explicit in the implementation.
